title: MTV No Filter: Tana Turns 21
tagline: ‘MTV No Filter: Tana Turns 21' is the first installment of a new reality series
synopsis: ‘MTV No Filter: Tana Turns 21' is the first installment of a new reality series following social media wild child TanaMongeau and her crazy crew as they navigate vlog life, studio time, partying, and finally becoming adults.

episodes.title: Tana Mongeau Gets Back At Her Cheating Ex
episodes.synopsis: Already on a journey to rebuild her reputation following 2018’s disastrous TanaCon, Tana Mongeau reclaims her future (plus, seeks a little revenge) in the midst of a bad break-up and her looming 21st birthday.

episodes.title: Tana's Friends Don't Trust Jake Paul
episodes.synopsis: When Tana rebounds with controversial YouTuber Jake Paul, her roommate, Ashly, worries she’s moving too fast with the wrong kind of guy. Plus, Tana goes head to head with Justina Valentine as a guest star on ‘Wild ‘N Out.’

episodes.title: Tana's Nipple Piercing Does NOT Go Smoothly
episodes.synopsis: Tana’s quest to get her nipple pierced leads to some revelations about her relationship with Jake Paul.

episodes.title: The Truth About Tana & Jake’s Marriage
episodes.synopsis: After a couple of false starts, Tana and Jake finally settle on a wedding date. Plus, the pair come to an agreement on the legality of their upcoming nuptials.

episodes.title: The Fight w/ Jake That Tana Didn't Want You To See
episodes.synopsis: You’ve been waiting for Tana to turn 21 and finally — finally! — it’s party time. Of course, her birthday party isn’t without drama; she and Jake get into a huge fight over who’s invited to the party.

episodes.title: The Side Of Tana’s VidCon You Didn’t See
episodes.synopsis: Two years since being banned from VidCon, Tana is back as a Featured Creator. See how she navigates her return without a scandal… well, kinda.

episodes.title: The Vows Tana Didn't Make At The Altar
episodes.synopsis: As Tana struggles to write her wedding vows to Jake, Jordan is made aware of a plot that could derail the #Jana nuptials.

episodes.title: Is Tana’s Manager Leaving Her For Good?
episodes.synopsis: When Tana's manager Jordan moves out of her pool house, she decides to sell his stuff at a yard sale. Meanwhile Trevor Moran helps Tana record a song with producer Mod Sun.

episodes.title: The Real Reason Tana & Jake Were Barely Speaking
episodes.synopsis: With Tana’s own relationship floundering, she decides to focus on Jordan’s love life by setting him up with adult film star Riley Reid.

episodes.title: How Tana & Jake’s Break Up Really Went Down
episodes.synopsis: Tana’s world is in disarray as her health issues reach a boiling point and she finally ends her relationship with Jake Paul.

episodes.title: Tana Faces A Shocking Diagnosis
episodes.synopsis: With her health at an all-time low, Tana finally visits a lung specialist and is given a shocking diagnosis. Meanwhile Ashly and Imari demand Jordan get them verified.

episodes.title: Tana & Jordan’s Biggest Fight Ever
episodes.synopsis: An all-out screaming match between Tana and Jordan puts their relationship in jeopardy. Meanwhile Trevor’s sobriety is threatened when he is invited to a bar with Tana and friends.

episodes.title: Tana & Imari’s Vegas Trip Goes Scarily Wrong
episodes.synopsis: With Paris Hilton’s help, Tana prepares to launch her first perfume line. Later, when Tana accompanies Imari to their hometown of Las Vegas they are faced with an emergency situation they never could’ve predicted!

episodes.title: Would YOU Forgive Tana? - Finale
episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of a traumatic event, Imari grows frustrated with Tana’s response. Meanwhile Jordan orchestrates the launch of Tana’s first perfume.
